apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(skin): center the title logo in the mobile hero (`082e83d5`)
- fix(home): swipe the hero carousel on touch (`f60b5f70`)
- fix(skin): center the mobile hero and inherit the button color in icons (`13862003`)
- feat(player): add a change source button and close the sheet on outside tap (`3b2ef577`)
- fix(player): seek on double tap (`6894d4ad`)
- fix(player): cap the mobile sheet width and center it (`d53d7bce`)
- fix(settings): fall back to Nuvio when the picked tracker is not connected (`d61c1e6c`)
- fix(settings): open the source dropdowns as sheets on mobile (`955f33f4`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.13...v0.3.14
